calibration.baseScrap: 3 + floor(min(wave, 200) / 10) + floor(max(wave - 200, 0) / 20) per enemy; Scrap Yield and completed Scrap Logistics multiply subsequent kill income.
calibration.runPrices: The first eight ranks keep their initial prices; subsequent quadratic price terms use 22 times the v2 coefficient. Cannon Cycle is unchanged. Permanent Salvage prices are unchanged. Saved v1/v2 runs retain their exact prior prices and income.
calibration.rationale: The v2 curve left wave 30 at 3 Scrap. Early ten-wave increases now make that 6. Applying that new income alone let modest level-20 builds reach the 5,000-wave bound, so the new economy also scales deep temporary prices while preserving starting prices and permanent costs. Fresh, level-20, level-150 and mature builds remain distinct; retained saves are never repriced.

method: Compiled production C# combat and shop owners. Explicit rotating combat/income/mixed priorities save for their next investment; rewards are credited at admitted kills, purchases occur after kills. First-clear awards appear once on earned trajectories.
limits: Matched and mature builds are gifted-profile probes, not earned progression claims. Only trajectory rows start from zero funds/levels.
The spending policy is a benchmark, not a player auto-buy feature or a strategy optimizer. Purchase intents do not measure human actions after UI batching.
5x duration is a deterministic simulation projection, not real-time browser performance or endurance.
Research completion/funding timelines are excluded here; specified ranks are fixture inputs. Full shared-Salvage opportunity cost belongs to the combined research measurement.
Two authored tiers only. Runs stop for the measurement at a declared wave bound; actual game runs do not stop there.
